title: The Art of Spending Money: Simple Choices for a Richer Life
description: From the bestselling author of The Psychology of Money and Same as Ever , lessons on harnessing the power of money to live a happier life Most of us don’t know how to spend money. We chase things that impress others but leave us cold. Or we save endlessly, afraid to spend on what would actually make life better. We confuse admiration with envy, comfort with excess, and utility with status. The Art of Spending Money doesn't provide budgets, hacks, or one-size-fits-all solutions. It gives you understanding of how your relationship with money shapes your decisions—and how to reshape it so money works for you. Morgan Housel’s work has helped millions rethink how they earn, save, and invest. Now he turns his attention to the other side of the equation: how to spend. With insight and warmth, he shows why the most valuable return on investment is peace of mind, why expectations matter more than income, and why doing well with money has less to do with spreadsheets and more to do with self-awareness. This book isn’t about getting rich. It’s about getting the most out of what you already have—and learning to want what’s worth wanting.  if(window.mix_csa){window.mix_csa('[cel_widget_id="tell-amazon-desktop_DetailPage_1"]', '#CardInstancefrQOcqSlatebVcn60vbhEA')('mark', 'bb')} if(window.uet){window.uet('bb','tell-amazon-desktop_DetailPage_1',{wb: 1})} ._tell-amazon-desktop_style_tell_amazon_icon_core_report__Fs1ah{color:#0f1111;color:var(--aok-sfs-color-page-primary-normal-fg,#0f1111);display:inline-block;-webkit-filter:none;filter:none;-webkit-filter:var(--aok-sfs-effect-mode-dark-color-silhouette-white,none);filter:var(--aok-sfs-effect-mode-dark-color-silhouette-white,none);height:20px;margin-right:4px;width:20px}._tell-amazon-desktop_style_tell_amazon_modal_spinner__3bz5K,._tel

title: Rich By Choice: Take Back Control, Master Your Money, and Design the Life of Your Dreams
description: Are you financially happy? When speaking at financial events, Dr. Nicholas E. Michels asks, “I’m here to help you become rich and wealthy. Is that okay with you?” A resounding “Yes!” echoes throughout the room. Next, he poses the question, “When do you want to retire?” The crowd is hooked. “Today!” they shout. Nicholas pauses for a moment, then looks across faces in the room. He asks the final question: “How much money do you need to live the life you want?” If you are like so many others that Nick helps, the answer to that question eludes you. Most people, while eager for wealth, have never truly considered what it would take to live the life of their dreams. Becoming Rich by Choice isn’t tied to a dollar amount; it’s about what you want money to do for you. In Rich by Choice , Nick uses his expertise as a seasoned financial advisor to show you how to: Build a solid Foundation so you know your purpose (why) and focus (who) for creating lasting financial security Understand the Fundamentals of earning, spending, and investing so you can achieve financial happiness Experience the Freedom that comes with mastering the secrets to financial freedom and experience the truth of being Rich by Choice No matter your age or current financial situation, it’s never too late to become Rich by Choice. title: The Forever Paycheck: The New Retirement Strategy to Spend More, Worry Less, and Never Run
description: THE INSTANT NEW YORK TIMES BESTSELLER “The playbook the personal finance industry should have written a generation ago.”—Bill Perkins “The clear, step-by-step plan that will help you stop guessing, stop stressing, and start using your money with confidence.”—Mel Robbins The new roadmap to financial longevity, from longtime TODAY show financial editor and New York Times bestselling author, Jean Chatzky You’ve been saving for retirement for decades. But what happens when you get to the end of your earning years? How do you take the money you’ve amassed and not only make it last as long as you do, but do it in a way that brings you the most fulfillment and the least amount of stress? This is something that you simply cannot afford to get wrong. If you do, you’ll either run out of money before you run out of time, or you’ll discover years too late that you didn’t use your money as much as you could have to enjoy your life. The solution is right here. It’s a paycheck that lasts for the rest of your life: a Forever Paycheck. With the power of a Forever Paycheck comes a simple, revelatory truth: you can spend more, and do more, than you think you can. The data shows that people entering retirement often can’t bring themselves to spend. But when their money comes as a steady monthly paycheck, they feel much more confident in using it to live life to the fullest. Many find they can spend double with no risk of running out. New research shows that a Forever Paycheck is even associated with better health, lower chances of disability, and a substantially longer lifespan. description: Wall Street Journal Bestseller “Jesse Mecham has achieved the impossible: a book on budgeting that is fascinating, entertaining, and practical. Read this book, follow his advice, then watch your bank account grow and your financial worries fade.” — Josh Kaufman, bestselling author of The Personal MBA and The First 20 Hours Experience a life free of financial stress and transform your relationship to money with this indispensable personal finance guide—the first book based on You Need A Budget’s proven method that has helped hundreds of thousands of people break the paycheck to paycheck cycle, get out of debt, and live the life they want to live. No one should tell you what to do with your money—only you know what’s most important to you. Always guiding you back to your true priorities, Jesse Mecham will fundamentally change the way you think about your money and what it can do for you. His proven budgeting method—four, simple rules—will transform money management from a paralyzing burden to a powerful tool, putting you in total control of your life: Give Every Dollar A Job. Be intentional about what you want your money to do before you spend it. Embrace Your True Expenses. Break up larger, less frequent expenses into smaller, more manageable amounts. By saving monthly for insurance premiums, holidays, or car repairs, when the time comes, your money is ready and waiting to do its job. Roll With The Punches. When life changes, so must your budget. Make adjustments and move along. Flexible budgets succeed because they’re guilt-free, realistic, and sustainable. Age Your Money.
